purpose: Static reference studies under specification §12.2; not runtime animation

paco.prompt: Create a polished STATIC CHARACTER POSE STUDY for the desktop companion Paco. Image 1 is the supplied appearance and pixel-art style reference, not an image to overwrite. Preserve his exact identity: short, round, overweight older middle-aged man, balding with gray side hair, full gray beard, friendly expressive face, bright blue tracksuit with white stripes, round exposed belly, blue-and-white trainers. Use crisp deliberate pixel-art clusters and stepped outlines throughout, a restrained consistent palette, no soft airbrushed gradients. White clean background. Landscape reference sheet with four spacious full-body isolated studies, consistent body/head scale across poses, no cropped feet or hands: (1) relaxed standing with warm slight smile; (2) effortful running toward the right, huffing but determined and friendly; (3) seated on the ground, relieved, wiping sweat from his forehead, warm tired eyes; (4) getting back to his feet with effort, one hand on knee, willing and optimistic. Fatigue must never look anxious, frightened, distressed or defeated. Keep all silhouettes separated and readable at desktop size. His belly, beard and blue-white stripes must remain recognizable across poses. These are independent design studies, NOT sequential animation frames, NOT a sprite atlas. No decorative setting, props, grids, captions, watermark, typography, or motion trails. Anatomically coherent hands and legs; friendly expression in every pose. Output one high-resolution landscape PNG reference sheet.

gatita.initial_prompt: Create one polished STATIC CHARACTER POSE STUDY for the desktop companion named gatita, using Image 1 strictly as her appearance and smooth outlined cartoon style reference. Preserve a small sweet brown tabby kitten, dark chocolate stripes, large bright green eyes, pink nose and ear interiors, cream muzzle/chest/paws, rounded ringed tail and soft proportions. Match the supplied distinctive face and forehead stripe pattern across all views. Use smooth clean illustration with expressive curved outlines and simple gentle shading, NOT pixel art and NOT photorealism. Clean white background, landscape reference sheet, five spacious isolated full-body studies with consistent head/body proportions and equal character scale: alert sitting like the reference; low playful crouch looking right with haunches ready to spring; joyful airborne bounding right with front paws lifted and back legs extended; rolling onto her side/back with soft belly visible and paws playfully curled; relaxed curled rest, eyes softly closed, contented purr expressed by peaceful face and tucked paws without text. Keep clear negative space around each silhouette and all ears/paws/tails completely inside the image. She is curious, affectionate and playful, never aggressive or frightened. Every view must have a coherent four-legged kitten anatomy and recognizable cream mittens, tabby markings and thick rounded tail. These are five independent design pose studies, NOT sequential frames and NOT a sprite atlas. No scene, props, frame boxes, grids, captions, typography, watermark, motion trails or purr symbols. Readable at small desktop size. Output one high-resolution PNG landscape reference sheet.
gatita.correction_prompt: Edit this gatita static character pose study. Change ONLY the background to a perfectly clean flat pure white #FFFFFF across the entire sheet; remove all brown/black gradients, glow, spotlight effects and ground shadows. Keep every kitten illustration, all five poses, their arrangement, full-body framing, scale, smooth outlined style, anatomy, expressions, green eyes, cream markings and tabby stripes unchanged. Preserve white whiskers with subtle warm gray outlines if needed for white-background visibility. There must be ample white negative space and no dark vignette, no scene, no ground, no captions or typography. This is a clean white-background design reference sheet, not an animation atlas.
